Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited conducted its Q1 FY27 earnings call, reporting revenue from operations of INR 716.38 crores and an EBITDA margin of 9.97%. During the quarter, the company commenced operations at its new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai, and is developing a new facility in Jaipur with an allocated capex of INR 47 crores. Management reiterated its FY27 revenue guidance of INR 3,500 crores, representing 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth. The company also announced a rights issue aggregating up to INR 100 crores to support working capital and inventory deployment. Shanti Gold International Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting strong financial growth with revenue from operations reaching Rs.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its top-line revenue target of INR 3,500 crores for the current year.
guidance.quote: See, basically, the guidance as of now, we are sticking to the guidance of INR3,500 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth between 30% to 40% and value growth between 50% to 60% compared to last year.
guidance.quote: So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects sustainable EBITDA margins to be around 7.5% to 8%.
guidance.quote: Management: EBITDA margin would be around 7.5% to 8%.

guidance.claim: Management targets a PAT operating margin of around 4%.
Management expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the business operational margin for PAT will be around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

guidance.claim: Management projects exports to grow from 10% to 20% or more.
guidance.quote: So I told you like this year will be like from 5% to we are going to go up to 10% or maybe more. Sorry, from 10% to 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand alongside rising disposable incomes.
demand_outlook.quote: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced strong demand across both export and local markets following recent industry exhibitions.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is, as I said, we just exhibited from the exhibition and we've come and we have a huge demand in export as well as in local.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising disposable income drives gold as a status symbol and investment.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing disposable income drives gold as status symbol & investment

demand_outlook.claim: Seasonal demand arises from weddings, Diwali, and harvest festivals.
demand_outlook.quote: Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Unique Indian designs attract global buyers with export growth potential.
demand_outlook.quote: Unique Indian designs attracting global buyers; export growth potential

demand_outlook.claim: Branded players are driving consumer trust in the Indian gold jewellery market.
demand_outlook.quote: Branded players (Tanishq, Kalyan, Malabar) driving consumer trust

demand_outlook.claim: Monthly jewellery investment schemes improve affordability.
demand_outlook.quote: Monthly jewellery investment schemes improve affordability

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers and retailers as they focus on footprintexpansion, inventory optimization, and faster design cycles.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company continues to witness healthy transactions particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

capex_expansion.claim: Shanti Gold successfully commenced operations at its new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The company allocated INR 47 crores in capex for its upcoming Jaipur facility, which is scheduled to be operational around November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur factory site spans 3 acres of land, with the initial phase covering 50,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

capex_expansion.claim: The establishment of a Dubai office is intended to increase the company's international presence over time.
capex_expansion.quote: Dubai office will increase our international footprint over a period of time.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during the IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: Once operational, capacity additions will take total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 9.97 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: The Q1 FY27 margin included an inventory gain of 2% to 2.5% resulting from a accounting method shift from FIFO to WAC.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding one-off inventory gains, expected EBITDA margins going forward are projected between 7.5% and 8%.
margins_costs.quote: So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year FY26, gross margin was 10.9%, EBITDA margin was 9.9%, and PAT margin was 6.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin: 10.9% EBITDA Margin: 9.9% PAT Margin: 6.9%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 67.01 crores and EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 67.01 crores as compared to INR 21.12 crores in Q4 FY25, registering a growth of 217.26% Y-oY. EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 7.88% as against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for the quarter stood at 7.88% as against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the existing Mumbai facility currently stands at 75%.
Designer and designer-studded jewellery accounts for 75% of total revenue, while plain gold jewellery represents 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: 75% of the revenue is from our designer jewellery and 25% from plain gold jewellery.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's installed capacity stands at approximately 6,700 kg per annum across Andheri and Marol.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: The existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai

orders_capacity.claim: The present capacity utilization of the existing factory is around 65%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 equity shares to raise up to INR 100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital raised via the rights issue will be deployed entirely into gold inventory and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now we -- the money what we are acquiring from rights issue is going to be invested completely in gold and working capital.

capital_allocation.claim: Management plans to keep the debt-to-equity ratio below 1x.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operating cash flow remains negative as the company maintains readily available inventory rather than operating on a strict order-to-order model.
risks_headwinds.quote: The reason for being negative cash flow is like, we utilize all the funds and we keep the stock readily. We don't deal on order-to-order basis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geopolitical situations and wars, such as involving Iran, have caused delays in the incorporation timeline of the Dubai subsidiary.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur manufacturing facility is expected to become operational around mid-November or December.
management_commitments.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to maintain its debt-to-equity ratio at less than 1x.
management_commitments.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Marol factory should start in a month or so, and the Jaipur factory should start by around September or October.
management_commitments.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
